Mapped: axis, 9.2 degree rotation, 46 m square at 30 m (the model is 3% wider there), 54 m base outline, wing footprint 27.9 x 6.5 m (model wing face 13.8 m from the axis). Estimated from photographs: the four-storey base (11 m A-frame arcade over a lobby set back 4.3 m, fascia, recessed strip, 20.4 m to the first window row), the window proportions (recessed pockets 0.5 m deep with a 2.0 m opening over a 1.6 m sloped sill on the lowest 14 rows, to 76 m; flat bronze-black panes 0.15 m proud of a plain wall above, to keep the near model light; 4 m floors; flat piers rather than the real bevelled shields), the wing start (128 m, about the 29th floor) and pitched tops (209.5 to 214.5 m), the louvres and the 6 m glass crown. The faces are one straight slope to a 1.2 m flat at 260 m; the real spire may steepen slightly. Not modelled: Redwood Park and its glass pavilion (OSM way 1316030009, provider-owned), the X-braced soffit frames in the arcade, the rooftop cameras, the interior. Night: about a fifth of the windows, the spire louvres and the crown are self-lit; the seasonal crown beacon is a single glow material.
